checks: The centered body D and concavity of r make the homothetic fibers an ordinary convex body. Positivity at zero and a<0<b make the origin interior.

The supporting tangent gives r(z)-zr'(z)≥r(0)>0. Differentiating u and R with the chain rule gives all six identities, including R''=-r^3 r''/D_r^3 and R-uR'=1/D_r. In the piecewise affine case the one-sided derivatives of R are ordered because h↦-h/(r-zh) has derivative -r/(r-zh)^2. The strict increase of u holds across every piece.
The volume Jacobian r^m in (q,z), multiplied by dz/du, gives r^(m+2)/D_r. Dividing the actual cap margin by r preserves its orientation and yields u+c·q≥0.

The raw coarea of z=-c·X is Lebesgue measure in the graph coordinates X. The section parametrization X=q/R(s) is injective since X fixes z and q. Its rank-one Jacobian has determinant R^(-m)(1-sR'/R)=wR, positive on each smooth piece. This checks raw rather than unit-normal normalization.

For c≠0 the omitted knot and endpoint preimages are hyperplane null sets in q. For c=0 the full section r(0)D is retained, with w(0)R(0)=r(0)^m even at a kink. Multiplication by X cancels the reciprocal factor and gives the horizontal first moment, and z=-c·X gives the vertical moment.
Source 9cc7f272d6dd1c14 §§1–2 gives the same dimensions, derivative signs, actual cap orientation and coarea pullback.

overlap.comparison: Uses actual centroidal sections, raw coarea and full horizontal vector moments for a single affine radius that vanishes at the pyramid apex. Its finite section is recovered by truncating that radius before the apex, choosing r(z)=(H-z)/(H+1) and using the section domain in the new lemma. The predecessor does not cover general positive concave radii or piecewise slopes.
Computes scalar coarea and axial moment for decreasing affine frusta, including their slope laws. It does not give the vector coarea pullback for a nonlinear concave radius.
Pushes full volume through division by a nonnegative affine coordinate and controls its marginal. It does not imply the nonlinear axial inverse or the raw section coarea identity here.

readability: At knots other than u=0, arbitrary pointwise choices for w are harmless for nonhorizontal cuts because the corresponding q slices are null. At u=0 the needed value is independent of the one-sided derivative.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The axial reciprocal is convex, and the exact volume, raw coarea, and vector first-moment identities hold in both stated regularity classes.
